purpose: Give hits, kills, heavy impacts, blasts, dashes, and overdrive projectiles distinct readable shapes without per-effect node growth.
camera: world-space 2D effects under the fixed 45-degree gameplay presentation
generation_model: deterministic Godot draw primitives; no generative model or third-party source
negative_constraints: no per-hit child nodes, unbounded particles, full-screen flashes, opaque effect fields, or gameplay changes
no collision, projectile speed, damage, pierce, lifetime, target, hit-stop, camera-trauma, or audio drift
